seed: Objects of type `hazard` under action ACTION6 with touching neighbours [marker,player,wall,wall] show mixed outcomes: no_change x1, gone x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the exact click position relative to the object, when the action is a click. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Two 4x4 blocks (10) move on floor 5: A1/A2 y-/+4, A3/A4 mirrored by side (centre<32); move only if all dest cells are 5.
Click on inactive marker 9 arms it (->11, blocks ->1); armed arrows move the 11 marker by 4 under the same floor rule; click on armed block 1 disarms.
Other clicks, A5 and blocked moves change only the HUD. Hazard A6 no_change vs gone hint = object renaming; in frames it is the clicked cell colour.
HUD: zero bars row 0 (right-aligned) and row 63 (left-aligned), width round(64a/150), a = actions this level including no-ops.
a is carried through a memo of returned frames; fallback = largest a for the bar width (0 if no bar). Unconfirmed: level-win behaviour, blocks entering marker cells.
